examples.english: I took care of my leather boots.
I wear rain boots on rainy days.

notes:
ブーツ (from English "boots") refers to footwear that covers the ankle and often extends up the leg.

TYPES:
- ⟦ロングブーツ→ロングブーツ：noentry⟧ (knee-high boots)
- ⟦ショートブーツ→ショートブーツ：noentry⟧ (ankle boots)
- ⟦ムートンブーツ→ムートンブーツ：noentry⟧ (sheepskin/UGG-style boots)
- ⟦レインブーツ→レインブーツ：noentry⟧ (rain boots)
- ⟦スノーブーツ→スノーブーツ：noentry⟧ (snow boots)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブーツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧ (to wear boots)
- ブーツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧ (to take off boots)
